contracts: Actual UI import of a private generated 3072x2048 chart; source SHA recorded before import and verified after scenario.
100% loads full decoded output and maps one image pixel to one backing pixel; full provider pixels match the CPU reference.
Real 256x128 composited scene patch preserves one-pixel detail; shifted/changed reference negative controls fail.
Fit/100%/Fit preserves image center at even and odd window dimensions, full saved document, revision, selection, identity and history flags.
A real held Exposure gesture publishes the exact 1024 interaction preview, then the exact 2560 final Fit preview after release.
Actual UI PNG export is 3072x2048 sRGB and matches the independent full-source CPU document exactly; Undo/Redo retains one gesture.
limits: These are local offscreen/software DPR1 results. GITHUB_ACTIONS=true selects the existing offscreen runner route; hosted_ci in the raw hardware block is not evidence of a remote run.
Native Cocoa/Metal/Retina DPR2 passes 3/3 on the available Mac. The Cocoa scene oracle permits at most one RGB8 step and exact alpha; provider and PNG export comparisons remain exact.
The generated chart is local to each child and separately SHA-checked; the global runner manifest covers its standard shared fixtures.
Independent oracle computation runs on the test GUI thread. Captured heartbeat stalls are not product latency/performance qualification.
No RAW, pan boundaries, physical input, display switching, memory pressure, GPU ordering/failure injection or full-release claim.
Blocking tidy checks pass; optional-access diagnostics remain because the analyzer does not establish the throwing require() precondition.
